# Feature: Saga Workspace UX + Lobby (Phase 0–1)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-12 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

Roadmap: Design `saga-workspace-ux-permissions` (Stufe A) — Phase 0 migrations + Phase 1 lobby/nav/lists.

## Intent

Make the Saga workspace and session entry usable: Overview must load (apply missing `session_recaps` migrations), Session create must land **immediately** in Lobby with a large join code (no countdown interstitial), and workspace nav must rename **Spieler-Charaktere**, add **Lore / Verlauf**, and replace stub sections with real scoped list shells (empty-ok until Dornhain seed Phase 3).

## Preconditions

- Local stack `sagadrive-db` + Kong running; user logged in as admin or player
- At least one saga project exists (e.g. Dornhain `SA-E979J`)
- Migrations through design Phase 0 applied on that DB

## Happy Path

- [x] Overview for an existing saga loads without `session_recaps does not exist`
- [x] Creating a session navigates within ~400ms to `/sagas/{SA}/sessions/{SE}/lobby` (no 2s „Session erstellt“ destination screen)
- [x] Lobby shows join **code** prominently (copyable) even before roster finishes
- [x] Lobby does **not** show `Session not found in saga` after a successful create
- [x] Nav label is **Spieler-Charaktere**; tab **Lore / Verlauf** exists and opens a section shell
- [x] Charaktere / NSCs / Items / Quests sections show a list shell or empty state with primary CTA (not the old „gehe zur Bibliothek“ stub-only copy as the only content)

## Edge Cases

- [x] Create without saga/session public ids fails closed (toast / stay) — no live redirect
- [x] Lobby with invalid public ids shows recoverable error + back
- [x] Session status `waiting` is accepted by project session mapping (not dropped)

## Regression

- [x] Library → Sagas still lists Dornhain
- [x] Dashboard → Alle Sagas opens library `?tab=adventures`
- [x] Session join-by-code path still works

## Assumptions

- Phase 2 (permission catalog UI) and Phase 3 (full Dornhain seed) are out of this ticket
- Welt remains Look preview until Phase 2/3 world maps shell (nav still present)
- Equal rights until Settings; no new RLS bundle tables in Phase 0–1

## Adaptive UI

- Surface: **Journey** (workspace + lobby)
- AU-TOUCH-44 / AU-CONTENT-WIDTH: primary CTAs `min-h-11`; lobby code block readable in narrow pane

## Security Coverage

- B-01/B-07: Lobby/session resolve still membership/RLS gated; URL public ids ≠ permission
- B-04: No client elevation of session status
- Out of scope Phase 0–1: bundle grant tables (Phase 2)
